items.title: NYDFS Sets May 2027 Deadline for Crypto Ad Policies
items.summary: BitLicense holders and crypto trust companies must prepare annually approved marketing policies covering risk disclosures, paid promoters and misleading claims.

items.title: Illinois crypto tax is impossible to enforce as written, crypto industry tells court
DTCC to Bring Tokenized Stocks and Treasuries to Solana in 2027
items.summary: Wall Street's main settlement firm will add Solana to its tokenization service, which went live last month on Canton and a private network.
